QUESTION:
Which setting controls how many times the logic that distributes messages across shards tries again before it gives up?

DOCUMENTATION EXCERPTS:
[d0596] config | partitioner.max_retries (PaderQueue 3.x) | version 3.x
# `partitioner.max_retries` (PaderQueue 3.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 3.x.

Maximum number of retry attempts of the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written before an operation is reported as failed.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `10` |
| Available since | 1.1 |
| Component | partitioner |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `partitioner.max_retries` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[partitioner]
max_retries = 10
```

---

# `acktracker.max_retries`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Maximum number of retry attempts of the acknowledgement tracker that records which messages consumers have confirmed before an operation is reported as failed.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `20` |
| Available since | 2.1 |
| Component | acktracker |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `acktracker.max_retries` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[acktracker]
max_retries = 20
```

# `partitioner.max_retries`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Maximum number of retry attempts of the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written before an operation is reported as failed.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `3` |
| Available since | 1.1 |
| Component | partitioner |
| Default changed | in 4.0 (see release notes) |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `partitioner.max_retries` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[partitioner]

```

[d0655] config | spool.max_retries | version 4.x
# `spool.max_retries`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Maximum number of retry attempts of the on-disk spool that buffers incoming messages before they are written to segments before an operation is reported as failed.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `10` |
| Available since | 3.0 |
| Component | spool |
| Default changed | in 4.0 (see release notes) |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `spool.max_retries` only if you observe problems with the on-disk spool that buffers incoming messages before they are written to segments, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[spool]
max_retries = 10
```

---

# `scheduler.max_retries`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Maximum number of retry attempts of the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time before an operation is reported as failed.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `5` |
| Available since | 3.0 |
| Component | scheduler |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `scheduler.max_retries` only if you observe problems with the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[scheduler]
max_retries = 5
```

response.content: The setting is `partitioner.max_retries`. It controls how many times the partitioner retries deciding which partition to write a message to before the operation is reported as failed.
